scope_change_reason: The drawn card's natural object (an independent moment/enclosure check of the MAS edge form of Theorem B2 (iii)) is occupied by fresh parallel work: claim https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18941591 and its completed result https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2340 (comments 18941591/18942032, 2026-10-15). The second card formal-interface-lemma is saturated by about twenty local packages and its live Lean object cannot be built on this host (no Lean toolchain installed). Taking the explicit open request item 1 of https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18934590 instead of the drawn card is a sanctioned scope change (autoresearch.md section 3): a third, different-method certificate for the exact cost 12 of the anti-Fano 12-line configuration. This keeps the card's acceptance gate (independence, source binding, positive cases, semantic failure controls, named existing checks and missing coverage).
actual_scope: Independent exact-F2 certificate that the anti-Fano 12-line configuration tied_min (pinned data research/three-total-decoders/data/tied_min.json at https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2111 head 98da76c2839ba38538b510420dec54546ccabf0b) has minimum admissible pairing cost exactly 12: every admissible B costs at least 12 and some B attains 12. Method: pure standard-library bitmask F2 linear algebra with explicit forced-zero triangular minor witnesses and complete branch-and-bound enumerations; no SAT/CP-SAT, no exchange argument, no char-2 jet, and nothing imported from the predecessor package. Coverage is exactly this pinned configuration at T = 3.

bottleneck_link: Independent pricing of a flagship predecessor claim (request item 1) with a structurally third method: it validates the rank-3 decoder evidence chain of PRs 2111/2162 without reusing either proof technique, and it names exactly which computational steps are needed beyond the MAS floor.
stop_rule: Stop at a completed certificate (both directions plus failure controls) or at the first admissible B with cost <= 11; no pivot beyond this one configuration in one session.
evidence: check_certificate.py (stdlib only): 18 PASS / 0 FAIL on CPython 3.13.11 and CPython 3.12.14 (identical output). Each block has exactly one rank<=3 filling (branch and bound over all fillings of its 8 columns); every one of the 2^24 completions of the remaining class-j columns has r_k + r_l >= 10 (exact minima 10,10,10); explicit triangular triples give each block rank >= 3 for every admissible B; an explicit class-block-diagonal B* attains cost 12 with block ranks (4,4,4); 6 rank-2 same-class fillings per class (216 = 6^3 class-block-diagonal optima, consistent with PR 2111 section 4). Semantic failure controls: tampered pin rejects, weakened forced zero breaks the witness, removing one used free bit kills the unique filling. cert_results.json records all counts. LOCAL outputs are in the PR at the recorded head.

falsification_test: The smallest falsifier is an admissible B with cost <= 11, which forces some block rank <= 3; the complete rank-3 filling enumeration plus the exhaustive residual completion enumeration would have to exhibit one. None exists: all 2^24 completions per filling have r_k + r_l >= 10.
